Zombies are at your window… so you nail some boards across it, like in the movies.
But movie boards fail twice… Hands fit through the gaps… and nails only hold by friction.
And friction still doesn't care about your feelings.
So, one sheet of plywood. No gaps… Four inches bigger than the hole, on every side.
Screw it into the wall studs, not the trim… Screws, not nails, every twelve inches.
Inside… they push it off your screws.
Outside… they push it into the wall.
Inside it is, then… Brace it to the floor, like the door.
Congratulations… you have properly barricaded a window.
